description: Attock Refinery Limited (ARL) is a petroleum refiner operating a refinery at Morgah, Rawalpindi, with a name plate capacity of 53,400 barrels per day. It traces its operations to 1922 and was incorporated in November 1978 to take over the business of the Attock Oil Company Limited relating to refining of crude oil and supplying of refined petroleum products, before being converted into a public limited company in 1979. The company describes itself as the pioneer and pacesetter in Pakistan's petroleum refining sector, and backs its product slate with an in-house Quality Control Laboratory accredited to ISO/IEC 17025.
headOffice: Attock Refinery Limited, The Refinery, Post Office Morgah, Rawalpindi, Pakistan
